name: sitelemetry
description: Audit production websites through Sitelemetry Cloud and loopback development sites with the signed Local Agent.

interface.longDescription: Audit production websites through Sitelemetry's OAuth-protected cloud service, or inspect localhost development sites through the signed loopback-only Local Agent. The local engine is delivered as a verified platform binary without shipping Sitelemetry's proprietary source. Cover security, technical SEO, AI visibility, analytics integrations, accessibility, and performance with prioritized evidence and remediation guidance.
defaultPrompt: Audit my verified website and prioritize the most urgent fixes.
Audit my local development site and prioritize fixes.
Run a full audit, improve the code, and verify the result.
